# Ferah Labs

> Ferah Labs is an independent iOS app studio building small, kind, focused apps. Every app is free to download with optional premium subscriptions via App Store in-app purchase. Honest by design: no dark patterns, no medical claims, and privacy-first defaults.

Studio contact: ferahlabs@gmail.com

## Apps

- [Witly: AI Rizz & Reply Coach](https://ferahlabs.com/witly/): An AI wingman that sounds like you. Paste a conversation or drop a screenshot and get three replies in your own voice, each with a short explanation of why it works — honest help, never a mask. iOS, Lifestyle. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782434460
- [Mola — Screen Time Blocker](https://ferahlabs.com/mola/): A reliability-first screen time blocker that gives you a break, not a cage. One tap, a gentle shield with Gentle/Balanced/Strict modes, scheduled blocks, and fully on-device data — no account, no sign-up. iOS, Productivity. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780052867
- [Aheste](https://ferahlabs.com/aheste/): A routine assistant designed with ADHD brains in mind — one unhurried step at a time, gentle timers, zero shame. iOS. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6778897823
- Nomzy: AI Calorie Tracker: An AI calorie tracker that estimates meals from a photo or a plain-text description, with honest confidence labels and tap-to-correct estimates it remembers. iOS, pre-launch — page and App Store link coming soon.
